root_cause.text: The mailbox-test driver frees the same channel object twice when the RX channel is aliased to the TX channel, because it unconditionally calls mbox_free_channel for both without checking if they are the same pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel` before freeing `tdev->rx_channel` in both the probe error path and the remove function, explicitly preventing the double-free of the reused channel.

Author: Wolfram Sang <wsa+renesas@sang-engineering.com>

    mailbox: mailbox-test: free channels on probe error
